name: Kenia Arias
description:
'''Kenia Arias''', known mononymously as '''Kenia''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|k|ɛ|n|j|ə}} {{respell|KEN|yə}}), is a [[Puerto Ricans|Puerto Rican]] and [[People of the Dominican Republic|Dominican]] recording artist, lyricist, and actor. She has independently released two mixtapes, one EP and three albums. She has collaborated with various independent rap artists throughout her career. Kenia has appeared in television shows, such as USA's [[Graceland (TV series)|Graceland]] and Netflix's [[GLOW (TV series)|
Glow]].
